**LEMON YELLOW**

**UX Designer JD**

title: Lighting Designer
description:
The Lighting Designer will be responsible for conceptualizing, developing, and implementing innovative and functional lighting solutions for a diverse range of architectural projects. This role requires a strong understanding of lighting principles, technology, and design software, as well as the ability to collaborate effectively with multi\-disciplinary teams and clients. The ideal candidate will have a passion for creating impactful illuminated environments while adhering to project requirements, budget, and sustainability goals.


* Develop creative and technically sound lighting design concepts from initial client briefs through to final implementation.
* Perform detailed photometric calculations, simulations, and analyses using industry\-standard software to ensure design performance and compliance.
* Select and specify appropriate lighting fixtures, lamps, and control systems, considering aesthetics, performance, energy efficiency, and cost.
* Prepare comprehensive lighting layouts, schedules, specifications, and detailed drawings for construction documents.
* Collaborate closely with architects, interior designers, electrical engineers, and other consultants to integrate lighting designs seamlessly into overall project plans.
* Ensure all lighting designs comply with relevant energy codes (e.g., ASHRAE 90\.1, IECC), building codes, and industry standards.
* Create high\-quality renderings, visualizations, and presentations to effectively communicate design intent to clients and project stakeholders.
* Manage project timelines, budgets, and resources related to lighting design components.
* Conduct site visits during various project phases, including construction administration and aiming, to ensure design integrity and quality of installation.
* Stay abreast of emerging lighting technologies, trends, and sustainable design practices.
* Review contractor submittals, shop drawings, and RFIs to ensure adherence to design specifications.
* Provide technical guidance and support to junior designers or project team members.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for someone who thinks beyond design. This role is for a creative individual who can bring ideas to life through compelling visuals across digital, print, and video formats. The ideal candidate should be able to conceptualize campaigns, design professional marketing collateral, enhance research reports, and create visually impactful presentations that improve communication with investors and clients.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Brand \& Marketing**

* Create promotional campaigns for new products, reports, events, and launches.
* Design social media creatives, banners, advertisements, and marketing assets.
* Develop festival greetings, company announcements, and brand communication creatives.
* Maintain consistency across all brand touchpoints.

**Publications \& Reports**

* Design visually appealing research reports, whitepapers, newsletters, and publications.
* Improve layouts, typography, icons, infographics, and data visualization.
* Beautify charts, graphs, and tables to make complex financial information easier to understand.
* Design annual reports and corporate publications.

**Investor \& Corporate Communication**

* Create professional investor presentations and pitch decks.
* Design company profiles, brochures, fact sheets, and corporate stationery.
* Develop templates for recurring research reports and presentations.

**Creative Strategy**

* Brainstorm visual concepts for campaigns and product launches.
* Work closely with the research, editorial, and marketing teams to convert ideas into impactful creative assets.
* Recommend new design styles, formats, and creative approaches that strengthen the company's brand identity.
* Develop creative content for social media platforms, ensuring consistent branding and engaging visuals across posts, campaigns, and other digital content.

**Required Skills**

* Strong command of Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign).
* Good knowledge of Premiere Pro and After Effects (or equivalent video editing software).
* Excellent understanding of typography, layout design, colour theory, and branding.
* Ability to create infographics and present data in a visually engaging manner.
* Experience designing presentations in PowerPoint or Google Slides.
* Understanding of UI principles is an added advantage.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 2–5 years of experience in graphic design, visual communication, or a similar creative role.
* Experience working with financial services, media, consulting, research, or corporate communications is preferred but not mandatory.
* A strong portfolio showcasing branding, publications, presentations, videos, and digital creatives.

**What We're Looking For**

* A creative thinker who enjoys solving communication problems through design.
* Someone who can convert text\-heavy documents into visually engaging experiences.
* An eye for detail, aesthetics, and storytelling.
* Ability to manage multiple projects while meeting deadlines.
* A proactive individual who brings fresh ideas instead of waiting for instructions.

**Bonus Skills**

* Experience with AI\-powered design tools.
* Illustration and icon design.
* Basic photography or videography.
* Familiarity with Canva, Figma, or similar design platforms.

**Why Join Us?**

You'll have the opportunity to shape how research and financial information is presented to investors, institutions, and market participants. Your work will directly influence our publications, campaigns, investor communication, and overall brand identity.

description:
### **Job Title**

Electrical Designer
### **Job Description**

**Electronics Engineer**

As an Electronics Engineer, you will play a critical role in designing and developing electronic subsystems including computing platforms, user interfaces, displays, and EMC\-compliant designs, for Philips Image Guided Therapy products. In this role, you will contribute to developing components and system elements using the V\-model methodology while aligning with user needs, product requirements, and business objectives.  



  

You will apply internal and external research insights, leverage emerging technologies, and ensure robust system\-level thinking throughout the design lifecycle. Your work will contribute directly to delivering high\-quality, reliable, and innovative solutions that enhance performance and enable exceptional clinical experiences.


**Your role:**

* Develop specifications for various subsystems like PC’s, Displays, User interface etc.
* Creating and/or participating in design reviews and risk assessments (e.g. FMEA)
* Alignment with other functions (mechanical, mechatronics, norm compliance, test and validation, purchase, quality, other).
* Conducting early integration tests on predefined prototypes and addressing supplier issues will also be your responsibility. You will follow up on any necessary actions.
* Execute verification of units and parts according to your assignment, with expertise in EMC testing will be a plus.
* Your role will require performing all tasks in line with established department processes.
* Your role will require safety test specification (IEC60601\-1\) for sub\-systems, Setup the test strategy and test plans to comply with international standards in alignment with the norm compliance department. Perform functional and compliance tests with documentation
* Created requirements, Designed, developed and verified, released at least 1 sub\-system of independently.

**You are a part of** Infrastructure department in Mechatronic Development Cluster within the IGT Fixed Systems R\&D organization. The department consists of an open and multi\-cultural team working towards new product introductions (NPI) of image guided therapy system.


**You are fit if:**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in electronic engineering or equivalent
* Minimum of 7\+ years of relevant R\&D working experience in medical domain.
* Experience in product design, development, and maintenance of released products. (preferable experience in IEC60601\-1\-2\).
* Excellent design documentation skills.
* Result oriented and self\-steering with a problem\-solving attitude.

title: Civil Designer Level II - Tekla
description:
**About us**

Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI\-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.


**The Role**

***As a Civil Designer Level II \- Tekla with Worley,*** you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.


* Develop and manage 3D structural models using Tekla Structures for civil and industrial projects.
* Prepare Structural Steel / Concrete GA drawings, and reinforcement detailing.
* Experience in shop drawings and fabrication drawings will be added advantage.
* Coordinate with architects, engineers, and project managers to ensure accuracy and compliance with design.
* Perform clash detection, model validation, and quality checks to maintain project integrity.
* Generate material take\-offs (MTOs), BOQs, and reports from Tekla models.
* Ensure adherence to international codes and standards (IS, AISC, BS, Eurocodes, etc.).
* Collaborate with multi\-disciplinary teams to deliver projects within timelines.
* Provide technical support during fabrication and construction phases.
* Maintain and update project documentation and revision control.

**About You**

To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:


* Bachelor’s degree/Diploma/Certificate course in Drafting / Modeling.
* Minimum 5 years of hands\-on experience with Tekla Structures in civil/structural projects.
* Strong knowledge of steel structures, concrete structures, and rebar detailing.
* Familiarity with BIM workflows and integration with other design software (AutoCAD, Revit, Navisworks).
* Ability to interpret engineering drawings and specifications.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Experience working in reputed engineering, EPC, or construction companies.

**Preferred Attributes:**

* Exposure to international and Indian industrial projects.
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

**Moving forward together**We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values\-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. We're building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.


And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there's a path for you here.


And there's no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
**Job description:**

We are seeking a talented and experienced UI/UX Designer to join our creative team. The ideal candidate will have a passion for creating intuitive and visually appealing user interfaces while understanding the importance of user experience. As a UI/UX Designer, you will play a crucial role in designing digital solutions that align with our business goals and enhance the overall user experience.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**User Research:**

* Conduct user research to understand user needs, behaviours, and preferences.
* Utilize findings to inform design decisions and create user personas.
* Wireframing and Prototyping:
* Create wireframes, mock\-ups, and interactive prototypes to visualize and communicate design concepts.
* Iterate designs based on feedback and usability testing.

**UI Design:**

* Design visually appealing and user\-friendly interfaces for web and mobile applications.
* Develop and maintain design systems to ensure consistency across platforms.
* Collaboration:
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including developers, product managers, and stakeholders, to bring designs to life.
* Communicate design decisions and rationale effectively.

**Usability Testing:**

* Conduct usability testing to gather feedback and identify areas for improvement.
* Implement insights from testing into design iterations.

**Responsive Design:**

* Ensure designs are responsive and optimized for various devices and screen sizes.

**Interaction Design:**

* Design interactive elements and transitions to enhance the overall user experience.
* Consider micro\-interactions that contribute to a seamless user journey.

**Visual Design:**

* Develop high\-fidelity visual designs that align with brand guidelines and enhance the overall aesthetic appeal.

**Accessibility:**

* Ensure designs comply with accessibility standards and create inclusive user experiences.

**Stay Updated:**

* Stay informed about industry trends, best practices, and emerging technologies in UI/UX design.
* Proactively suggest and implement design improvements based on evolving trends.

**Qualifications:**

* 1\-3 years of experience as a UI/UX Designer or similar role.
* Experience and proficiency in brochure creation and designing engaging infographics.
* Proficiency in design tools such as Adobe Creative Suite, Sketch, Figma, or similar.
* Familiarity with video creation tools, such as Adobe Premiere, After Effects, or other relevant platforms.
* Strong portfolio showcasing a variety of UI/UX design projects.
* Solid understanding of user\-centered design principles.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
* Knowledge of front\-end development languages (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) is a plus.
* Bachelor’s degree in design, Human\-Computer Interaction, or a related field.

title: Web Designer-Intern
description:
Job Title: Intern – Web Designer

About us:

icogz is an industry leader in enterprise\-grade AI, revolutionizing business operations with its innovative Aryabot™ Neuro\-Symbolic AI engine and Autonomous Intelligence Architecture (AIA™). Designed to provide real\-time AI\-powered insights, icogz empowers organizations to make data\-driven decisions and enable intelligent automation across all departments. By democratizing access to advanced data analytics, icogz bridges the gap between complex data insights and actionable strategies, allowing every team to operate smarter and faster. With a unified view of enterprise data and over 200 proprietary algorithms, icogz is pioneering the future of business intelligence and decision\-making.

Role Overview

We are looking for a creative and curious Intern \- Web Designer to join our team on a 3\-month internship, with the possibility of full\-time conversion based on performance and business requirements.

This role is ideal for someone passionate about UI/UX design and eager to learn how thoughtful design comes together with modern, AI\-assisted development. You'll get hands\-on exposure to the full design process — from wireframing and user flows through to mockups and landing pages — while also learning how tools like Cursor and Lovable are changing how designs get built. This is a great opportunity for someone early in their career who wants to build a strong, practical foundation in both design and vibe coding.

Key Responsibilities

UI/UX \& Visual Design

* Support the creation of wireframing, user flows, mockups, and high\-fidelity visual design for websites, landing pages, and web assets.
* Apply core principles of typography, color theory, and visual hierarchy to produce clean, engaging designs.
* Help design and maintain responsive design layouts that work well across desktop, tablet, and mobile.
* Contribute to and follow existing design systems and component libraries to keep designs consistent with brand guidelines.
* Assist with structuring page layouts and site flow using sound information architecture.

Research \& Usability

* Support basic user research and usability testing activities to help the team understand user needs and pain points.
* Help identify usability issues and suggest design improvements based on findings.
* Learn to apply interaction design principles to make experiences more intuitive.

AI\-Assisted Development \& Rapid Prototyping

* Get hands\-on exposure to AI\-assisted development and vibe coding using tools like Cursor and Lovable to quickly bring design concepts to life.
* Practice prompt engineering to generate and iterate on layouts, components, and prototypes efficiently.
* Use no\-code/low\-code tools and rapid prototyping approaches to support rapid iteration on design ideas.
* Learn basic HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to better understand how designs translate into working web pages.

Handoff, QA \& Collaboration

* Support design\-to\-code handoff by preparing clear specs, assets, and documentation for developers.
* Assist with cross\-browser testing to confirm designs display correctly and consistently.
* Help apply accessibility (WCAG) guidelines to make designs more inclusive.
* Collaborate closely with designers, developers, and marketing team members, and take part in design reviews and feedback sessions.
* Use tools such as Canva for quick visual assets and supporting marketing/design needs.

Continuous Learning

* Stay curious about emerging design trends, UX methodologies, accessibility standards, and AI\-assisted design and development tools.
* Contribute ideas to improve design processes and workflow efficiency.

Required Skills

* Strong interest in UI/UX design, web design, or a related field, with some coursework, personal projects, or freelance work to show for it.
* Basic understanding of responsive design and mobile\-first thinking.
* Foundational skills in typography, color theory, layout, and visual hierarchy.
* Familiarity with at least one design tool such as Figma, Adobe XD, Canva, or similar.
* Willingness to learn HTML, CSS, and modern AI\-assisted development tools like Cursor or Lovable.
* Good communication skills and openness to feedback.
* Ability to manage time across multiple small tasks in a fast\-paced environment.
* High attention to detail and genuine care about producing polished work.

Preferred Skills

* Some exposure to HTML, CSS, or JavaScript.
* Familiarity with vibe coding, prompt engineering, or no\-code/low\-code tools.
* Basic understanding of user research, usability testing, or user flows.
* Awareness of accessibility (WCAG) standards and inclusive design practices.
* Interest in design systems or component libraries.
* Any personal or academic projects involving landing pages, mockups, or prototypes.

Qualifications

* Pursuing or recently completed a degree, diploma, or certification in Graphic Design, Web Design, UI/UX Design, Visual Communication, Multimedia Design, or a related field.
* Equivalent self\-taught experience, professional certifications, or bootcamp training will also be considered.
* Candidates should share a portfolio or samples of relevant design work, even if from coursework or personal projects.

What We Offer

* Hands\-on exposure to modern UI/UX design and AI\-assisted development workflows.
* Mentorship and guidance from experienced designers and developers.
* Practical experience with tools like Cursor, Lovable, and Canva.
* A collaborative, fast\-paced work environment.
* Potential conversion to a full\-time role based on performance and business needs.

To Apply: Please share your resume along with your portfolio and links to WordPress websites or landing pages you have designed or developed to hr@icogz.com

Work Location: In person
